notes.title: GYATM Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Bit of a DR event recently where we lost the disk with the 1.0.2 update source, but we recovered and proceeded to get even more little bugs fixed.
We also did some work on localization fixes and a requested UI change, and of course included a neat little easter egg for you guys to find.
Still testing the concept of 'removing' already built domes, but so far we haven't found a good way to do that without making the game a whole lot easier. After all, resource allocation mistakes are supposed to have consequences.

Thanks for playing! You guys are [b]awesome[/b], and we appreciate all the support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35641109/7806f36189233cacce4e6866e4dbd5d7e7f95ac5.gif[/img]

notes.title: GYATM Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thanks to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/houradaygamer/]Hour a Day Gamer[/url], a new bug was uncovered last night. We got it fixed and all ready to roll today.
We also fixed a few other minor bugs, did some work on the textures and in-game scene changes, and of course included a neat little easter egg for you guys to find.

Thanks for playing! You guys are [b]awesome[/b], and we appreciate all the support.

notes.title: GYATM Dragon Edition Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi all!

Little "behind the scenes" pic for you guys.
